method: Visual inspection of actual source images with baseline annotation overlays. Only pages actually displayed and inspected count. Overview frames are full-frame at half scale and do not prove small-object pixel precision. Dense review uses native crops, with exact crop bounds in each tag.manifest.json; review of a crop does not establish review of pixels outside it. Rendered-only pages and automatic flags never count.
